Alan Cumming Stars in 'Tip Toe,' a Melodrama Exploring Queerness and Masculinity

Alan Cumming stars in 'Tip Toe,' a British melodrama described as harrowing, which explores themes of queer liberation and masculinity in crisis. The film aims to 'traumatize' audiences, contrasting with Cumming's role in 'Traitors.'
